reviewedFindings.evidence: The only dynamic RegExp constructor is local to boms(); its tag selector argument is invoked only with the fixed literals type, scope, groupId, artifactId and version. No request, repository file content, package metadata value or other attacker-controlled string becomes the RegExp pattern.

The plain Socket performs TCP connect only. The selected address is checked for drift, then the socket is wrapped by SSLSocket with HTTPS endpoint identification, SNI, TLSv1.2/TLSv1.3 only and startHandshake(). JdkSecureChannel retains the SSLSocket, and request/API-key bytes are written only through that TLS socket after the handshake.

diffDesignerValues derives JSON-pointer tokens from Object.keys(), while applyChange writes target[token] and target[key] without explicitly rejecting __proto__, constructor or prototype. The server ApprovalDefinition uses fixed records, which reduces normal API provenance risk, but that does not prove every client-local merge input is runtime-closed. Positive callsite/provenance evidence or an explicit reserved-key guard is still required.
